title: constancea nevinii

It is known for its unique, modified leaves that form pitcher-like structures to capture and digest insects, making it a carnivorous plant. Constancea nevinii has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its antibacterial and antifungal properties.
